text.aria-label: Title text 'With the weights fixed, R-DW loses to L-1d only when both readings are removed. CRPS minus L-1d's at 24 to 120 h; negative favours the arm. Dot: difference. Bar: 95% interval from 5 month blocks (near min to max). Line: same as L-1d. Late readings are taken from earlier days.'
text.tspan: With the weights fixed, R-DW loses to L-1d only when both readings are removed.
CRPS minus L-1d's at 24 to 120 h; negative favours the arm. Dot: difference. Bar: 95% interval
from 5 month blocks (near min to max). Line: same as L-1d. Late readings are taken from earlier days.
